units.source_text: 黄昏过后，有人轻轻地敲门，说是从宇治来的。

en.t: After dusk, someone knocked softly at the gate and said they had come from Uji.

units.source_text: 弁君推想是薰大将的使者，便命人开门。

en.t: Ben no Kimi guessed that it was a messenger from General Kaoru, so she ordered someone to open the gate.

units.source_text: 但见一辆车子进入门内，她觉得奇怪。

en.t: But when she saw a carriage come inside the gate, she thought it strange.

units.source_text: 便有人来报告：“要拜访尼僧老太太。”

en.t: Then someone came to report, "He wishes to call on the elderly nun."

units.source_text: 而所提的却是宇治山庄附近庄园的经理人的姓名。

en.t: Yet the name given was that of the manager of an estate near the Uji villa.

units.source_text: 弁君就膝行到门口来接见。

en.t: Ben no Kimi moved forward on her knees to the doorway to receive him.

units.source_text: 此时天空洒着微雨，冷风吹入门内，

en.t: At that moment a fine rain was falling, and a cold wind blew in through the gate,

units.source_text: 带进妙不可言的香气来，方知是薰大将来了。

en.t: bringing with it an indescribably wonderful fragrance, and only then did she know that General Kaoru had come.

units.source_text: 这个优越的人物突然降临，而此地乱七八糟，毫无准备，

en.t: Such an exalted person had arrived suddenly, while the place was in disorder and wholly unprepared,

units.source_text: 使得大家心慌意乱，忙叫“怎么办呢！”

en.t: throwing everyone into panic as they cried out, "What are we to do?"

units.source_text: 薰大将叫弁君传言：“我想在这幽静的地方

en.t: General Kaoru asked Ben no Kimi to convey his words: "Here in this quiet place,

units.source_text: 把近来思慕之苦心向小姐陈述一番。”

en.t: I would like to tell the young lady something of the anguish of longing I have felt of late."

units.source_text: 浮舟狼狈不堪，不知如何作答。

en.t: Ukifune was utterly flustered and did not know how to answer.

units.source_text: 乳母着急了，说道：“大将特地来访，

en.t: Her nurse grew anxious and said, "The General has gone out of his way to visit us,

units.source_text: 难道可以不招待他，叫他回去么？

en.t: so how could we possibly fail to receive him and send him away?

units.source_text: 派个人到常陆守邸内去悄悄地告知夫人吧，离开这里并不远的。”

en.t: Send someone quietly to the Hitachi Governor's residence to inform the lady; it is not far from here."

units.source_text: 弁君说道：“何必如此疏远呢！

en.t: Ben no Kimi said, "Why be so distant?

units.source_text: 年轻人互相谈谈，不会立刻亲密起来。

en.t: Young people may talk with one another without becoming intimate at once.

units.source_text: 况且这位大将性情异常温厚周谨，

en.t: Besides, this General is exceptionally gentle, considerate, and discreet by nature,

units.source_text: 若非小姐心许，决不会任情而动。”

en.t: and unless the young lady herself gives her heart, he would never act on impulse."

units.source_text: 此时雨势稍大，天空全黑，

en.t: By then the rain had grown a little heavier, and the sky was completely dark,

units.source_text: 便有一个守夜的值宿人操着东国方言告道：

en.t: when one of the night watchmen on duty announced in an eastern provincial accent:

units.source_text: “东南角上的土墙坍损了，很不谨慎。

en.t: "The earthen wall at the southeast corner has collapsed, and it is very unsafe.

units.source_text: 这位客人的车子倘是要进来的，赶快进来，把大门关上吧。

en.t: If this guest's carriage is to come in, bring it in quickly and close the main gate.

units.source_text: 这种客人的随从人都是糊里糊涂的。”

en.t: The attendants of guests like this are always careless."

units.source_text: 薰大将听不惯这种口音，觉得刺耳难闻。

en.t: General Kaoru was unused to that accent and found it harsh and unpleasant to hear.

units.source_text: 他吟唱着“佐野谁家可庇身”的古歌，

en.t: He murmured the old poem, "At whose house in Sano might one find shelter?"

units.source_text: 就在那乡村风的檐下坐下了。

en.t: and sat down beneath those rustic eaves.

units.source_text: 吟诗曰：

en.t: He then recited a poem:
